title: semantic_apply_rule wired into rule_application as a use_real_nli-gated fallback for apply_rule's exact-lemma miss
goal: Close the gap EXP-061 measured standalone but never wired: a fact phrased without the rule's own trigger verb lemma falls through to lookup_fallback today, even when it clearly satisfies the rule's condition by meaning.
method: A paraphrased fact (no shared lemma) checked with the flag omitted (today's exact behavior, abstains) and set (resolves via the new fallback). An exact-lemma fact checked with the flag set, to confirm it still takes the ordinary path, never the fallback. A genuinely unrelated fact checked with the flag set, to confirm abstention still works when nothing actually matches.
results_prose: A fact phrased without the rule's trigger verb lemma, use_real_nli omitted (today's default): 'inconclusive' -- apply_rule's exact-lemma search finds no fact_passage, same as before this wiring existed. The SAME case with use_real_nli=True: 'supported', matched via the new 'verb_semantic' trace kind, citations=['F1', 'R1']. An EXACT-lemma fact with use_real_nli=True still resolves through the ordinary exact-match path ('verb' kind), never the semantic fallback -- the fallback only ever runs after the exact search already failed. A genuinely unrelated fact still correctly abstains even with the flag set.
conclusion: lab.common.rules.semantic_apply_rule -- measured standalone in EXP-061, never wired into the live rule_application stage -- now runs as an explicit fallback when apply_rule's exact-lemma search finds no fact_passage at all, gated on the EXISTING use_real_nli flag (no new parameter). Zero regression: every caller who leaves use_real_nli at its default, or whose fact already shares the rule's trigger lemma, takes the exact same path as before this wiring existed.
scale_down: One rule, one paraphrased fact, one exact fact, one unrelated fact -- a proof the dispatch/gating/citation wiring works end to end, not a benchmark of the real NLI checkpoint's own paraphrase-matching precision at scale (already measured separately in EXP-061/EXP-031).
follow_ups: The fallback does not run forward_chain (multi-rule chaining) the way the exact-match path does for a derived fact -- a semantically-matched fact that itself triggers a second rule stops after the first consequence, a deliberate scope limit, not an oversight.
models_used: lab.common.real_encoders.real_nli (DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli), only when the caller already set use_real_nli=True -- the classical lab.common.nli.judge remains the default judge_fn for any other (test/direct) caller of semantic_apply_rule.
